text.value: Our done-for-you clients pay $40,000.00 to $60,000.00 up front for the build. Most of them already sell what they know and already have a small team around them. text.value: Think about that from our side. A full build is weeks of work for my team. On Revenue Share we put all of it in for a small piece of the price, because we see what you can become. text.value: That is why we pick only two or three members of our community a month. My team and I do the building, and every build gets everything we have. text.label: Text: The idea
text.value: The idea

text.label: Heading: Why we call ourselves a talent agency.
text.value: Why we call ourselves a talent agency.

text.label: Text: The oldest deal there is.
text.value: The oldest deal there is.

text.label: Text: A singer or an athlete with a gift has always had somebody b
text.value: A singer or an athlete with a gift has always had somebody behind them. The talent agent does the work nobody sees: the bookings, the deals, the business side. The talent shows up and does the one thing they are great at. The talent agent gets paid out of what the talent earns. That arrangement has been around as long as show business. We do the same thing for people who know something other people want to learn.

text.label: Text: It is the whole company.
text.value: It is the whole company.

text.label: Text: Steven James Consulting is a modern day talent agency. That
text.value: Steven James Consulting is a modern day talent agency. That is what the whole company is, and Revenue Share is one way in. When somebody asks me what I do for a living, that is my answer. My team and I take coaches, authors, speakers and influencers and show them how to make money with their attention and their product, and then we do the heavy end of the work for them. Our done-for-you clients get the same agency behind them. The only thing that changes on this page is how the build gets paid for.

text.label: Text: We go first.
text.value: We go first.

text.label: Text: Here is what a talent agent does that almost nobody else in
text.value: Here is what a talent agent does that almost nobody else in business will do. He puts the work in before he is paid for it. He backs a person on what they know and what he believes they can become, long before there is anything to split. That is the Revenue Share Partnership in plain words. You put in $3,995.00. My team puts in a full build, the same one that sells for $40,000.00 to $60,000.00. We are betting our own time on you. That is why we say everybody gets a shot, and why we take our time choosing.

text.label: Text: What a talent agent does.
text.value: What a talent agent does.

text.label: Text: Whatever you do for a living, you have to promote yourself t
text.value: Whatever you do for a living, you have to promote yourself to make it work. Most people were never shown how. So the first job of a modern day talent agent is to show you how to promote yourself on the free platforms, and then my team carries the heavy end of it for you. The second is to package what you know into something a person can buy. The third is to build the modern website and the sales system that sells it. That sales system is the Revenue Engine. I do not see anybody else offering all of that in one place.

text.label: Text: What is missing.
text.value: What is missing.

text.label: Text: Our whole model is one line: Attention + Your Product = Doll
text.value: Our whole model is one line: Attention + Your Product = Dollars. Three things have to stand behind the stage for that line to add up. A website you own, so the people watching you have one address to go to. Something with your name on it that a person can pay for, so their interest has somewhere to land. And a way to stay in front of them until they are ready, so you are still there on the day they decide. You bring the knowledge and the face. Those three are the part we build.

text.label: Text: Who this is for.
text.value: Who this is for.

text.label: Text: The coach with a handful of clients who all came by word of
text.value: The coach with a handful of clients who all came by word of mouth. The author with a book and nowhere to send the readers who liked it. The person with a small following who answers the same five questions in their messages every week. You know your subject. People already come to you for it. You have just never had a business built behind you, and you cannot pay for the whole build today.

text.label: Text: If you can pay today.
text.value: If you can pay today.

text.label: Text: If you already sell what you know, have a small team and can
text.value: If you already sell what you know, have a small team and can write the check, our done-for-you service on the home page is the straighter road. That is done for you. You go straight to a discovery call, and my team builds from there. If you have more time than money right now, do it yourself from my book, the blueprint. This page is done with you. All three doors lead into the same agency. If you cannot tell which is yours, fill in the application on this page and say so. That call is where we work it out together.

text.value: Our whole model is one line: Attention + Your Product = Dollars.

My team writes it, designs it and builds it around you: your story, what you sell, and a way for a person to buy or book a call with you right on the page. It is where a stranger turns into a buyer, and it is where your e-book and your podcast will sit. Every video, clip and episode you put out sends people to that one address.

text.value: A lot of the work goes here. We sit down with what you know, get it out of your head and package it into a book with your name on the cover. My team does the writing, the layout and the cover. You tell us what you know, and you check that it sounds like you. Then it goes on your website with a price on it, and people buy it there. text.label: Text: This is system two, the Automated Organic Content Engine. It
text.value: This is system two, the Automated Organic Content Engine. It is the self-promotion, and we carry the heavy end of it. One recording from you does not stay one recording. My team turns it into a steady run of videos, clips and episodes across every platform your audience is on. You record once and you show up everywhere, all week. Every piece tells the viewer the same thing: go to the website. That is how free attention ends up on a piece of the internet you own.

text.label: Text: Somebody always answers.
text.value: Somebody always answers.

text.label: Text: System three is Speed to Lead. When a person comments, sends
text.value: System three is Speed to Lead. When a person comments, sends a message or fills in a form, they are interested right now. An hour later they have moved on. So we train an AI employee on you: what you sell, who it is for and how you talk. It answers every one of them in seconds, day or night, and keeps the conversation going. You stop losing buyers because you were asleep, on a call, or having dinner with your family.

text.label: Text: Proof and second chances.
text.value: Proof and second chances.

text.label: Text: Systems four and five are Automated Five Star Reviews and Da
text.value: Systems four and five are Automated Five Star Reviews and CRM Mastery. We set it up so every person you help gets asked for a testimonial, every time, without you remembering to ask. The next buyer sees that proof before they ever talk to you. Then everyone who followed you, bought once or went quiet gets reached again with something else you offer. Those people already know you. That is the easiest money you will ever make.

text.label: Text: Paid ads come last.

text.value: System six is Paid Ads = Booked Appointments, and we add it last. We do not start by spending money on advertising. First the free attention has to turn into paying clients. What reaches you is a call on your calendar with a person who wants what you teach, and never a list of names to chase.

text.label: Text: Who does the work.

text.label: Text: Those six systems together are the Revenue Engine. My team b
text.value: Those six systems together are the Revenue Engine. My team builds each one and connects it to the others so they run as one. AI employees then run them around the clock. They do the answering, the following up and the asking that no one person could keep up with. My team stays behind them, and I am on your account personally. This is done for you, from the first page to the last system. You get a working copy of my own business with your name on it, built by the same people who build it for clients paying $40,000.00 to $60,000.00.

text.value: You record. You talk to the people who are ready to buy. You take care of the people who paid you. That is your week. text.value: People are slow to buy from somebody new, and they should be. It usually takes seven to ten times of seeing you and hearing you before a stranger trusts you with their money. The Revenue Engine is built to keep you in front of them that long. Your part is to keep showing up while it does. That is the whole reason the weekly commitment matters, and on Revenue Share it matters twice, because we get paid when you do.

text.value: You also need to have done the work. An expert's income is a direct reflection of the time and effort they put into their business.
